people.name: Curt Randall Thompson
people.bio_note: Managing Partner and co-founder with 31 years in the OCIO industry. Spent 23 years at Hirtle, Callaghan & Co. (the first-ever OCIO firm in America) before co-founding Global Strategic in 2018 alongside Don Callaghan. Holds a BS (1989) and MBA (1994) from Penn State University. Oversees the firm's largest private wealth, family office, and nonprofit institutional relationships and sits on the investment policy committee.
people.bio_source: Firm website (gsisus.com/team/curt-thompson, gsisus.com/history-of-gsis); corroborated via WealthMinder.com and LinkedIn confirming Hirtle Callaghan tenure and OCIO pioneer narrative

people.name: Donald Edward Callaghan
people.bio_note: Managing Partner and co-founder; CRD 38501 reflects a long career (37+ years in the industry per WealthMinder). Co-built Hirtle, Callaghan & Co. into the first OCIO firm to exceed $20 billion in AUM before launching Global Strategic in 2015/2018. Education per LinkedIn: The Wharton School (1971-1973) and an earlier degree (1964-1968). Active in market commentary and published financial media pieces on active manager selection.
people.bio_source: Firm website (gsisus.com/history-of-gsis); corroborated by WealthMinder.com advisor profile (wealthminder.com/financial-advisors-scottsdale-AZ/donald-callaghan/368252) confirming CRD, tenure, and Scottsdale office, plus LinkedIn for education/activity
people.phase4_note: Phase 4 verification (2026-07-03): education and CRD/tenure details independently corroborated via WealthMinder. However, records show he left Hirtle, Callaghan & Co. in 2012, three years before co-founding Global Strategic (2015) -- the bio's framing of continuous involvement through founding isn't well supported; there's an unexplained 3-year gap. Verdict: PARTIAL.

people.name: Nicholas Guido Botticelli
people.bio_note: Chief Investment Strategist and Head of the Southeast Office, with over two decades managing large, complex investment portfolios. Most recently VP of Investment Strategy in the Investment Office at Exelon Corporation, leading investment strategy, asset allocation, hedge funds, and private credit across Exelon's $43 billion in assets. Before that, Director of Investment Strategy at Hirtle Callaghan, and spent 17 years at Verizon Investment Management Corporation as Executive Director of Global Investments. Attended Pace University.
people.bio_source: IC Research consultant database profile (ic-research.com/investment-consultant/nicholas-nick-botticelli) and LinkedIn, corroborating career history beyond the firm website
people.phase4_note: Phase 4 verification (2026-07-03): the cited source (ic-research.com) was re-fetched directly and does not contain the claimed Exelon/$43B/Verizon career details -- those facts appear consistent across multiple search results (likely sourced from gsisus.com, which could not be directly re-fetched) but the specific citation doesn't support them as given. Verdict: PARTIAL.

people.name: Matthew Keith Underwood
people.bio_note: Holds CFA, CAIA, and CDAA (Certified Digital Asset Advisor) designations. Earned a Bachelor's in Business Information Systems from Arizona State University (2009) and an MBA in Finance from the University of Arizona's Eller College of Management (2012). Independent sources list his current role as Director of Investments and Head of Research & Portfolio Management (differs from the CCO title in our ownership records — noting the discrepancy rather than silently resolving it). Prior experience at The Vanguard Group, BB&T, and Retirement Wealth Advisors. Serves as Past President/Advisor to the Executive Board of CFA Society North Carolina, a 1,500+ member professional organization, after previously serving as its President.
people.bio_source: LinkedIn and U.S. News Financial Advisors profile (money.usnews.com/financial-advisors/advisor/matthew-underwood-5907386), both corroborating credentials and CFA Society NC leadership beyond the firm website

people.name: Hana Callaghan
people.bio_note: Genuine effort made to confirm identity and relationship to Donald Callaghan, but results are ambiguous. A person named Hana Callaghan living in Scottsdale, AZ has a corporate background in wealth management, estate planning, and family wealth transfers at Goldman Sachs, and later became a certified life/executive coach (Erickson International, 2019) running 'InSight Coach, LLC.' However, her own coaching-site bio does not mention Global Strategic Investment Solutions, Donald Callaghan, or any spousal relationship — it only states she lives in Scottsdale with 'our 8 year old daughter.' No independent source directly ties this Hana Callaghan to the firm or confirms she is Donald Callaghan's spouse/family member — not assumed.
people.bio_source: hanacallaghan.com/me (coaching bio); general web search snippets referencing a Scottsdale-based Hana Callaghan with a Goldman Sachs background — identity/relationship to Donald Callaghan NOT independently confirmed

firm_note.text: Founded by Curt Thompson and Donald Callaghan, who are described as pioneers of the Outsourced Chief Investment Officer (OCIO) model, having built Hirtle Callaghan into the first OCIO firm to surpass $20 billion in AUM before launching this firm. Employee-owned, with offices in Scottsdale AZ, Jupiter FL, and Durham NC.
firm_note.source: Firm website (gsisus.com/history-of-gsis); corroborated by WealthMinder.com advisor profile for Donald Callaghan
